test_match_to_schema: test the LazyFrame.match_to_schema method to match a lazy frame's schema to a target schema
test_match_to_schema_missing_columns: test inserting missing columns into a LazyFrame using match_to_schema with missing_columns=insert
test_match_to_schema_extra_columns: test ignoring extra columns in a LazyFrame using match_to_schema with extra_columns=ignore
test_match_to_schema_missing_struct_fiel: test inserting missing struct fields into a LazyFrame using match_to_schema with missing_struct_fields=insert
test_match_to_schema_extra_struct_fields: test ignoring extra struct fields in a LazyFrame using match_to_schema with extra_struct_fields=ignore
